/lab/the-bug-that-makes-you-laugh.title: The Bug That Makes You Laugh: What a Theory of Jokes Says About Building AI — TwinzLab
/lab/the-bug-that-makes-you-laugh.description: Are jokes just bugs in our mental models? We dig into Roman Yampolskiy's theory of humor and what it means for AI, AI safety and building products with AI.
h1: The Bug That Makes You Laugh: What a Theory of Jokes Says About Building AI
h2: Jokes as bugs, laughter as a bug report
The safety angle: humor as an immune system
Why the funniest joke won't be funny to us
What this means if you build with AI
p: A computer scientist argues that every joke is a glitch in your mental model, and that makes humor a surprisingly useful lens on AI, its blind spots and the products we build with it.
